name: cmsprobe-v1
setup: pip install -q 'uproot>=5.3,<6' 'awkward>=2.6,<3' numpy fsspec aiohttp requests
run: cd /work && python -m py_compile cmsprobe.py test_cmsprobe.py && python -m unittest -v test_cmsprobe > /out/tests.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/tests.txt; exit $rc
cd /work && sha256sum cmsprobe.py test_cmsprobe.py SCOUT-CMSTOPO-v0.1.md | tee /out/sha256.txt && pip freeze > /out/versions.txt

cd /work && OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 timeout 4800 python cmsprobe.py --out-dir /out --entries 100000 > /out/run.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^CMSPROBE_' /out/run.txt; tail -n 30 /out/run.txt; exit $rc
